audit_items.proof_trace: The non-zero fee invariant is enforced by two guards: (1) at borrow time, `assert!(fee != 0, ...)` (L814) stores a guaranteed-positive fee in the hot-potato FlashLoan struct; (2) at repay time, `assert!(fee_coin.value() != 0, ...)` (L851) inside the referral branch prevents any rebate from fully zeroing the fee. The no-referral path inherits the borrow-time guarantee directly via `fee_coin = coin.split(fee, ctx)`, so a 0-value fee coin is unreachable on either path.
